components.name: GraphTable
components.title: Table
components.description: Framed data table with an optional footer row for totals.
components.when: Good when the numbers belong in a spreadsheet.
components.not: Grouped sections are Sheet. Label/value rows are Spec.

components.name: GraphFlow
components.title: Flow
components.description: Process diagram with nodes on a dashed arrow. Accent a node to highlight a path.
components.when: Good for a pipeline, a request path, or walking through a change.
components.not: A dated list is Timeline. A schedule with start and end is Gantt.

components.name: GraphBars
components.title: Bars
components.description: Two bar groups side by side, drawn with glyphs. The right group is usually the larger one.
components.when: Good for a before and after, or any two small histograms.
components.not: A ranked list is Rank.

components.name: GraphRank
components.title: Rank
components.description: A list of labels with a bar of characters and a number on the right.
components.when: Good for traffic, coverage, or anything you'd sort highest first.
components.not: Two histograms side by side is Bars. A table of numbers is Table.

components.name: GraphCells
components.title: Cells
components.description: Grid of filled and empty cells, drawn with glyphs. Useful for density or comparing two sets.
components.when: Good for a small grid of filled and empty cells.
components.not: A share of a hundred cells is Waffle. A year of days is Activity.

components.name: GraphMeter
components.title: Meter
components.description: Progress bar drawn with = characters. Empty slots stay as dashes.
components.when: Good for one value between 0 and 1, shown as a fill.
components.not: Actual versus a target is Bullet. Parts of a whole is Stack.

components.name: GraphSpark
components.title: Spark
components.description: Sparkline from block characters. Values scale to the highest point.
components.when: Good for a handful of numbers when you don't need an axis.
components.not: If you need a y-scale, use Plot.

components.name: GraphTree
components.title: Tree
components.description: Nested tree with branch glyphs. Accent a node to highlight it.
components.when: Good for nested files or an org chart.
components.not: A timeline or a table.

components.name: GraphTimeline
components.title: Timeline
components.description: Vertical list of dates. Mark one row as current with the accent color.
components.when: Good for steps in order, with one marked as current.
components.not: A punch list is Check. A schedule with start and end is Gantt.

components.name: GraphStack
components.title: Stack
components.description: Stacked bar for parts of a whole. Different glyphs per segment instead of colors.
components.when: Good for parts of a whole on one track.
components.not: There is no pie chart. Use Waffle if you want a share of cells.

components.name: GraphFunnel
components.title: Funnel
components.description: Steps get narrower as values drop. Percentages compare to the first step.
components.when: Good for steps that get narrower as people drop off.
components.not: A ranked list is Rank. A process diagram is Flow.

components.name: GraphGantt
components.title: Gantt
components.description: Schedule chart. start and end are fractions from 0 to 1 along the track.
components.when: Good for work that overlaps on a shared calendar.
components.not: A dated log is Timeline.

components.name: GraphPlot
components.title: Plot
components.description: Line or area chart built from columns of block characters.
components.when: Good when the series needs a y-scale.
components.not: A handful of points with no axis is Spark.

components.name: GraphWaffle
components.title: Waffle
components.description: Grid of 100 cells. The value sets how many are filled in.
components.when: Good for a share shown as a grid of about a hundred cells.
components.not: Labeled parts of a whole is Stack.

components.name: GraphDiff
components.title: Diff
components.description: List with add, remove, and unchanged rows. Works for changelogs or bundle sizes.
components.when: Good for showing what was added, removed, or kept.
components.not: A list of numeric before and after is Slope.

components.name: GraphInvoice
components.title: Invoice
components.description: Document table for invoices and quotes. From, bill-to, line items, and a totals block.
components.when: Good for from, bill-to, line items, and totals.
components.not: A generic table is Table.

components.name: GraphCompare
components.title: Compare
components.description: Feature matrix. Cells are text or true/false, drawn as ✓ and –.
components.when: Good for putting two options side by side.
components.not: Exact numbers on both axes are Matrix. Numeric ranks are Rank.

components.name: GraphStat
components.title: Stat
components.description: A row of large numbers with labels.
components.when: Good for two to four large numbers, with no sparkline.
components.not: One number with a trend is KPI. A live clock is Timer.

components.name: GraphKpi
components.title: KPI
components.description: One large number with a sparkline under it.
components.when: Good when one number is the headline and the rest is context.
components.not: Several numbers with no trend is Stat.

components.name: GraphSpec
components.title: Spec
components.description: Aligned label and value rows. Spec sheets, shipping labels, type samples.
components.when: Good for aligned label and value rows, like a spec sheet.
components.not: Large headline numbers are Stat. A table with headers is Table.

components.name: GraphActivity
components.title: Activity
components.description: GitHub-style contribution grid. Pass dated counts; weeks, months, and intensity are derived.
components.when: Good for daily counts over months, like a contribution grid.
components.not: One month of marks is Calendar. Up or down days is Uptime.

components.name: GraphHeatmap
components.title: Heatmap
components.description: Labeled rows and columns with the same intensity glyphs as Activity. Punchcards, hours, anything 2d.
components.when: Good for a labeled grid of intensities.
components.not: Exact numbers on both axes are Matrix. A contribution calendar is Activity.

components.name: GraphCalendar
components.title: Calendar
components.description: One month as a seven-column grid. Marked days use the accent. today is wrapped in brackets.
components.when: Good for one month with a few days marked.
components.not: A year of activity is Activity.

components.name: GraphWaterfall
components.title: Waterfall
components.description: Running total as floating bars. First row is the start, last is the end, signed values in between.
components.when: Good for a running total as floating bars.
components.not: Parts of a whole is Stack.

components.name: GraphUptime
components.title: Uptime
components.description: One glyph per day. ok, degraded, down, or empty. Wraps every 30 days.
components.when: Good for a status per day, or the blast radius of an outage.
components.not: A heatmap or an activity grid.

components.name: GraphLatency
components.title: Latency
components.description: Percentile band chart. Each column stacks p50, p50-to-p95, and p95-to-p99. Mark a point spike to draw a caret above it.
components.when: Good for percentile latency over time, like a SRE dashboard.
components.not: A single sparkline is Spark. An error budget is SLO.

components.name: GraphSlo
components.title: SLO
components.description: Error-budget burn bar over a window. Spent fills the bar, remaining is the dim trail. Burn rate, time-to-empty, target, and actual follow below.
components.when: Good for an error budget or burn-rate panel.
components.not: Percentile bands are Latency. A usage limit is Quota.

components.name: GraphQuota
components.title: Quota
components.description: Usage against a hard limit, with a reset date and end-of-window projection. Billing-style: the headline figure, the X-of-Y copy, and pace are surfaced together.
components.when: Good for usage against a hard limit with a reset date.
components.not: An error budget is SLO. A single progress fill is Meter.

components.name: GraphSlope
components.title: Slope
components.description: Two figures per row with an arrow between. Up uses the accent, down recedes.
components.when: Good for a before and after number on each row.
components.not: Two bar groups is Bars. A ranked list is Rank.

components.name: GraphBullet
components.title: Bullet
components.description: Actual versus target on a shared track. The marker is the target.
components.when: Good when a number has a goal sitting on the same track.
components.not: A single fill from 0 to 1 is Meter.

components.name: GraphTimer
components.title: Timer
components.description: Elapsed time, how long ago, or the time of day. The numbers update every second.
components.when: Good for uptime, last deploy, or a clock in the corner.
components.not: Time left until a date is Countdown. A static number is Stat.

components.name: GraphCountdown
components.title: Countdown
components.description: Time left until a date. After that it shows a short label you pass in.
components.when: Good for a freeze, a launch, or a window that closes.
components.not: Elapsed time since a start is Timer.

components.name: Graph
components.title: Frame
components.description: Dashed frame wrapper used by every graph. Compose with GraphTitle, GraphBody, GraphRule, GraphTrack, and GraphTick. corner picks the character at each corner.
components.when: Good when you're putting together a custom figure.
components.not: If the chart already exists, install that one instead.

components.name: AsciiDiagram
components.title: ASCII Diagram
components.description: Renders raw ASCII or Unicode diagrams with live tokens: titles, arrows, corners, and glyph blocks pick up the accent automatically.
components.when: Good for pasting an existing ASCII drawing and having it themed.
components.not: An interactive editor is DiagramEditor. A specific wave diagram is Amplifier.

components.name: DiagramEditor
components.title: Diagram Editor
components.description: An embeddable playground: presets, a glyph palette, auto-align, and copy-as-Svelte or .svx. Takes no props.
components.when: Good for letting a user build and export a diagram interactively.
components.not: A static render is AsciiDiagram.

components.name: AmplifierDiagram
components.title: Amplifier
components.description: A small taste wave runs through an AI stage and comes out amplified. The gain slider scales the output wave live.
components.when: Good for showing signal gain through a stage.
components.not: A generic ASCII render is AsciiDiagram.

components.name: NestedRadiiDiagram
components.title: Nested Radii
components.description: Interactive explainer for nested border radius: two sliders update the ASCII art, the formula, and a real CSS preview together.
components.when: Good for explaining how nested border-radius works.
components.not: A generic ASCII render is AsciiDiagram.

components.name: PromptLoopDiagram
components.title: Prompt Loop
components.description: The prompt-and-iterate loop as a six-step player. Steps light up in turn, with play, pause, seek dots, and a speed slider.
components.when: Good for showing the prompt-iterate feedback cycle.
components.not: A generic step player is FlowPlayer. A workflow DAG is Workflow.

components.name: MetricsTableDiagram
components.title: Metrics Table
components.description: A cost ledger as ASCII: label, tool calls, and time per row, with a total row. Static by design.
components.when: Good for a cost or usage ledger with tool calls and time.
components.not: A generic data table is Table.

components.name: GraphAgni
components.title: Agni
components.description: A vedic fire in a havan kund: heat rises from the pit mouth in a breathing column while sparks drift and fade. Decorative, and frozen under reduced motion.
components.when: Good for a decorative vedic fire scene.
components.not: An open flame is Fire. A candle row is Diya.

components.name: GraphAum
components.title: Aum
components.description: The om figure inked stroke by stroke, then held by a resonance crest that travels the stroke order and rests. Frozen settled under reduced motion.
components.when: Good for the om glyph as an animated figure.
components.not: A lotus bloom is Mandala. A spinning sun is Surya.

components.name: GraphBoot
components.title: Boot
components.description: A deploy log: per-step progress bars, check on pass and cross on fail, plus a total summary row. Frozen mid-run under reduced motion.
components.when: Good for a deploy or startup sequence animation.
components.not: A scripted shell session is Terminal. A dependency tree is Deps.

components.name: GraphCron
components.title: Cron
components.description: A zero-dep cron parser. The next N runs of any standard 5-field expression laid out on a tick timeline, with a date and HH:MM ribbon under each marker. Frozen on the first run under reduced motion.
components.when: Good for visualizing the next runs of a cron expression.
components.not: A dependency tree is Deps. A ticker marquee is Ticker.

components.name: GraphDamru
components.title: Damru
components.description: Two triangles meet at a point and pulse on every beat of an 8-beat Adi tala, with a ripple expanding and fading each time. Frozen on a clap beat under reduced motion.
components.when: Good for a rhythmic pulse animation tied to a tala.
components.not: A fire scene is Agni. A flowing river is Ganga.

components.name: GraphDeps
components.title: Deps
components.description: A dependency tree from a manifest, with version tags on every row and a depth-mark column on the left. Rows cascade in from the root, then a brief rest. Frozen fully-revealed under reduced motion.
components.when: Good for a package dependency tree with versions.
components.not: A nested file tree is Tree. A boot sequence is Boot.

components.name: GraphDiya
components.title: Diya
components.description: A row of oil lamps lights left-to-right one by one, then breathes together, occasionally one gutters and relights. Frozen lit under reduced motion.
components.when: Good for a row of oil lamps during a festival scene.
components.not: A vedic fire is Agni. A flowing river is Ganga.

components.name: GraphFire
components.title: Fire
components.description: Demoscene fire in shade glyphs: heat rises from a hot base and cools as it climbs. Decorative, and frozen under reduced motion.
components.when: Good for a demoscene-style fire effect.
components.not: A vedic fire is Agni. Matrix-style rain is Rain.

components.name: GraphFlame
components.title: Flame
components.description: ASCII flame graph: nested rows of frames where each frame's width is its share of time. Cycles through hot leaves and lights the ancestor chain. Frozen on the first leaf under reduced motion.
components.when: Good for a profiling flame graph animation.
components.not: A demoscene fire is Fire. A state machine is State.

components.name: GraphFlowPlayer
components.title: Flow Player
components.description: A play/pause step-player for ordered process steps. The active step lights up and its detail unfolds beneath it.
components.when: Good for walking through ordered steps one at a time.
components.not: A DAG workflow is Workflow. A static flow is Flow.

components.name: GraphGanga
components.title: Ganga
components.description: Three meandering flow lines cascade in steps, with a lone diya flame bobbing downstream. A calmer GraphStream. Frozen mid-flow under reduced motion.
components.when: Good for a flowing river scene.
components.not: A terminal stream is Stream. A fire is Fire.

components.name: GraphHash
components.title: Hash
components.description: Any string to its 64-bit FNV-1a digest as a 4-tier glyph-checkerboard fingerprint with a scan line that sweeps the grid and a hex readout underneath. Same input always yields the same fingerprint.
components.when: Good for visualizing a string fingerprint.
components.not: A spinner is Spinners. A typewriter is Typewriter.

components.name: GraphJapa
components.title: Japa
components.description: A 108-bead mala with a marker advancing clockwise, a soft tail behind, and a corner counter; the whole ring shimmers on every revolution. Frozen mid-mala under reduced motion.
components.when: Good for a mala counting animation.
components.not: A diya row is Diya. A sun wheel is Surya.

components.name: GraphLife
components.title: Life
components.description: Conway's Game of Life in block glyphs with faint death trails, toroidal edges, and a gen/pop readout. Play, step, or reset.
components.when: Good for a cellular automaton simulation.
components.not: A Mandelbrot zoom is Mandel. A scope trace is Scope.

components.name: GraphMandel
components.title: Mandelbrot
components.description: A slowly zooming ASCII Mandelbrot drifting into seahorse valley, its dense core tinted accent. The brand piece.
components.when: Good for a fractal zoom animation.
components.not: A mandala bloom is Mandala. Conway's Game is Life.

components.name: GraphMandala
components.title: Mandala
components.description: Lotus-petal rings bloom ring by ring from a bindu, with K-fold rotational symmetry; one canonical petal is rotated K times. Every seed is a different mandala. Frozen fully bloomed under reduced motion.
components.when: Good for a symmetric lotus bloom animation.
components.not: A Mandelbrot zoom is Mandel. A spoked sun is Surya.

components.name: GraphPulse
components.title: Pulse
components.description: A live uptime strip that appends one blip per tick, with a legend, percent-up, and a last-check caption.
components.when: Good for a live uptime blip strip.
components.not: A KPI stream is Stream. A static uptime grid is Uptime.

components.name: GraphRain
components.title: Rain
components.description: Matrix-style glyph rain: columns fall at their own speeds behind a bright head, trails fading to faint. Decorative.
components.when: Good for a Matrix-style rain effect.
components.not: A fire is Fire. A flowing river is Ganga.

components.name: GraphScatter
components.title: Scatter
components.description: An x/y dot plot in the glyph grid, with a 4-char y-axis gutter and an x-axis ribbon under the plot. Pass trend for a single-row linear-regression strip below. Reveals left-to-right, then a brief rest. Frozen fully-revealed under reduced motion.
components.when: Good for an animated x/y scatter with optional trend line.
components.not: A scrolling oscilloscope is Scope. A static plot is Plot.

components.name: GraphSurya
components.title: Surya
components.description: A spoked sun that rises from behind the horizon line, turns one spoke at a time, and sets again. Frozen mid-morning under reduced motion.
components.when: Good for a rising sun animation.
components.not: A mala is Japa. A mandala bloom is Mandala.

components.name: GraphScope
components.title: Scope
components.description: A scrolling oscilloscope window over any number series, drawn in block glyphs; the newest column glows accent.
components.when: Good for a scrolling oscilloscope trace.
components.not: A static sparkline is Spark. An animated scatter is Scatter.

components.name: GraphSequence
components.title: Sequence
components.description: ASCII sequence diagram: participants on columns, labeled dashed arrows between them, and activation bars on each lifeline. The current message and its endpoints light up. Frozen on the first message under reduced motion.
components.when: Good for an animated sequence or interaction diagram.
components.not: A state machine is State. A workflow DAG is Workflow.

components.name: GraphSpinners
components.title: Spinners
components.description: A family of glyph spinners — slash, dots, bounce, bar — with a muted label. Holds frame one under reduced motion.
components.when: Good for a loading indicator.
components.not: A ticker marquee is Ticker. A typewriter is Typewriter.

components.name: GraphState
components.title: State
components.description: ASCII state-machine chart: state boxes in a 2x2 grid with labeled transitions on the arrows. The current state and its outgoing transition light up. Frozen on the first state under reduced motion.
components.when: Good for an animated state-machine diagram.
components.not: A sequence diagram is Sequence. A workflow DAG is Workflow.

components.name: GraphStream
components.title: Stream
components.description: A live terminal KPI: big current value, a one-row glyph sparkline that appends, and an updated-Ns-ago caption.
components.when: Good for a live-streaming KPI value.
components.not: An uptime blip strip is Pulse. A typewriter is Typewriter.

components.name: GraphTerminal
components.title: Terminal
components.description: A scripted shell session: a prompt gets typed character-by-character, output blocks stream right after, the whole script loops. Combines a typewriter and a stream into one frame.
components.when: Good for a scripted terminal session animation.
components.not: A typewriter is Typewriter. A boot log is Boot.

components.name: GraphTicker
components.title: Ticker
components.description: A one-row status marquee that rotates whole OK / WARN / DOWN tokens, colors staying attached.
components.when: Good for a rotating status marquee.
components.not: A spinner is Spinners. A typewriter is Typewriter.

components.name: GraphTypewriter
components.title: Typewriter
components.description: Text that types itself with a blinking block cursor, holds, and loops. Reduced motion shows the full text.
components.when: Good for text that types itself out.
components.not: A terminal session is Terminal. A status marquee is Ticker.

components.name: GraphWorkflow
components.title: Workflow
components.description: A typed workflow diagram: nodes and edges as data, auto-laid out as a top-down DAG, with a play/pause step-player that lights up the path.
components.when: Good for a DAG workflow with animated step activation.
components.not: A linear step player is FlowPlayer. A static flow is Flow. A sequence diagram is Sequence.
